title: pr-pane 0.3.4: make the /prs autoOpen shell hint pasteable
summary: The 0.3.3 hint's <marketplace> placeholder is a shell redirect when pasted, and the bare form prints the invalid value true|false.
description: A code review of the v0.3.3 catalog bump (evolv-marketplace) found that pasting 'claude plugin configure pr-pane@<marketplace> --values-stdin' into bash or zsh redirects stdin from a missing file named marketplace and writes stdout to a file named --values-stdin, and that the bare form's {"autoOpen":"true|false"} is not a valid value. Jeremy approved the fix in the evolv-marketplace session.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every hint command is concrete and runnable as printed: pr-pane@evolv-marketplace as the id, plus one plain sentence telling other installs to use the id claude plugin list shows
The bare form prints one command to turn auto-open on and one to turn it off; enable and disable print only their own
A test fails if any hint line has <, > or | outside the leading echo pipe, or a value other than true or false
validate --strict, plugin test and tsc pass

implementationNotes: AC1/AC2: live 'claude -p --plugin-dir plugin "/prs autoOpen"' printed two concrete commands (true, then false) for pr-pane@evolv-marketplace plus the claude plugin list sentence; each printed line run in zsh with a stub claude received the JSON on stdin and args 'plugin configure pr-pane@evolv-marketplace --values-stdin', and no 'marketplace' or '--values-stdin' file was created. Tests assert enable and disable print only their own value.
AC3: expectPasteable() in tests/pane.test.ts; with INSTALL_ID set back to 'pr-pane@<marketplace>' the suite went 23 pass / 3 fail, restored it is 25/25.
